summary: Chase Issuance Trust filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $1.25 billion credit card receivable securitization on May 28, 2026. The issuing entity issued notes backed by the receivables; depositor Chase Card Funding LLC and sponsor JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. were also involved. No specific per-share price, premium, or board recommendation is provided because this is a routine asset-backed securities issuance, not a special situation. The filing is a standard current report for structured finance activity and does not trigger any special-situations category. This is a routine securitization with no event of the type listed.
